text: Yes, deforestation occurred on this asset in 2023. Earth-observation data shows a tree-cover loss of about 0.7 hectares (1.2% of the asset) within the year. The change was detected by satellite imagery and confirmed by reference maps, indicating the area was forested in 2020. However, the cause of the loss—whether due to logging, fire, or other factors—is not specified. The evidence does not determine if the activity was legal or illegal, nor does it identify responsible parties. The asset is a 58.1-hectare rural property with mixed land use.
